name: design-skills
description: Deterministically compile platform design guidelines (Apple HIG, Material 3, WCAG, …) into versioned, cited Agent Skills. No LLM in the loop.

scripts.build:public: bun run build apple-design && bun run build material-3
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:public && bun run src/e2e/run.ts && bun run src/e2e/validate-negative.ts && bun run src/e2e/coverage.ts && bun run src/e2e/manifests.ts
